LAW AND MOTION 301, PETITIONER PHILADELPHIA INDEMNITY INSURANCE COMPANY'S PETITION FOR RELIEF FROM GOVERMENTAL CLAIMS STATUE IS CONTINUED TO 10/14/09 PER MOVING PARTY. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189
OPPOSITION TO PETITION FOR ORDER FOR RELIEF FROM GVT CLAIMS STATUTE FILED BY RESPONDENT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO

LAW AND MOTION 301, JUDGE BUSCH MADE A DISCLOSURE ABOUT HIS WIFE, CATHARINE BARNES, A DEPUTY CITY ATTORNEY IS A MEMBER OF THE GOVERNMENT OVERSIGHT AND COMPLEX TRANSACTION. SHE IS NOT INVOLVED IN THIS CASE AND THAT HE DOES NOT VIEW HER EMPLOYMENT AS A BASIS FOR RECUSAL. NO OBJECTIONS WERE MADE. THE MATTER WAS ARGUED. PETITIONER PHILADELPHIA INDEMNITY INSURANCE COMPANY'S PETITION FOR RELIEF FROM GOVERMENTAL CLAIMS STATUE IS GRANTED. THE REQUEST WAS DONE TIMELY AND THE COURT IS GOVERNED BY THE PRESUMPTION OF LAW THAT CASES SHOULD BE DECIDED ON THE MERITS. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J.
